contract.claim_reference_rule: A lane may cite a registered claim ID, but mathematical credit is bounded by that claim's authority_status, PROVES, DOES_NOT_PROVE, source locks, and audit receipt.
contract.active_frontier_rule: active_frontier_refs point into ACTIVE-FRONTIER.json and express current OWNER/ATTACKS/CONSUMES routing only; they do not make EX1-EX5 separate mathematical Stages and do not grant proof credit.
contract.promotion_rule: EX -> MAIN requires an AUDITED terminal EX claim plus a separate explicit current-target promotion adapter claim. LANE-ADAPTERS.json itself never promotes.
contract.purpose: External reference map only. Existing MAIN-STATE files remain authoritative for routing and are not rewritten or promoted by this adapter.
contract.scratch_rule: Scratch results are not claim dependencies for MAIN/EX promotion. They must first become a retained PROVISIONAL claim with exact source locks.
contract.new_lane_enrollment_rule: Any new Stage32 EX lane must be added here with exact state_path, startup_path, claim_refs, and active_frontier_refs before it can promote mathematical credit to MAIN.

lanes.notes: MAIN owns the active frontier. HDECK and [73,97,235] are audited; open frontier nodes remain goals unless independently audited.
EX1 attacks V6 carrier existence/nonexistence and the two nonbijective-normalization branches; its accumulated candidate remains provisional/re-audit pending.
EX2 attacks actual-member reconstruction and complete-linear-system nonexistence; bootstrap contract only.
EX3 attacks O210/cover/monodromy and related Q602/member-level interfaces; bootstrap contract only.
EX4 consumes the audited abstract H-deck/survivor frontier and attacks absolute W-line marking and Q602 exclusion; no absolute marking credit exists yet.
EX5 attacks receiver-breadth/FULL178 routing and the numerical-census input to Stage32 closure; bootstrap breadth contract only.
